fix.method: planar projection of the CMC-cage patch onto its average normal, scaled into a 0.16 UV square and placed in free UV space after a 512x512 occupancy scan with a 4-cell pad

diagnosis: the existing UVMap was complete EXCEPT for exactly 64 faces carrying no UV at all -- these are precisely the 64 quads of the CMC deformation cage created in Stage 4A R2 (3 concentric rings x 16 + 4x4 core), which were never unwrapped.  Nothing else was wrong: 0 flipped, 0 unintended overlap, winding consistent.
fix_scope: LOCAL only.  The 64 faces were planar-projected onto their own average normal and placed into free UV space found by a 512x512 occupancy scan.  UVs are per-loop attributes, so no neighbouring face, no vertex and no polygon was touched.  The rest of the hand was NOT re-unwrapped.
intentional_overlap: none present and none introduced (overlap fraction 0.000000 before and after)
verdict_reason: the UVs could not support a semi-realistic hand material + subtle nails with 64 faces undefined, so a LOCAL fix was required; everything else was left alone because it was already fit for purpose
